title: Dry stone wall of stacked irregular slabs
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of a dry stone wall: irregular, tapered flat stones stacked in rough courses without mortar, deep dark voids, small chinking stones wedged into the joints, lichen patches and moss. Use for field walls, terraces, ruins and rural buildings.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python dry_stone_wall.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: courses
parameters.meaning: Rough courses of stones across the tile height.

parameters.name: stone_length
parameters.meaning: Mean stone length in tile widths.

parameters.name: irregularity
parameters.meaning: Variation of stone size, thickness and outline.

parameters.name: tilt
parameters.meaning: Random rotation of the stones out of level.

parameters.name: gap
parameters.meaning: Width of the dark voids between stones.

parameters.name: chinking
parameters.meaning: Small filler stones wedged into the joints.

parameters.name: moss
parameters.meaning: Moss in the crevices and on the lower edges of stones.

parameters.name: lichen
parameters.meaning: Pale lichen colonies on the faces.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Grey limestone field wall with lichen spots and chinking stones.

presets.name: gritstone_moss
presets.description: Brown gritstone in thick courses, mossy crevices, few chinks.

presets.name: slate_coursed
presets.description: Thin dark slate slabs in many tight courses.

presets.name: rubble_rough
presets.description: Rough, chunky rubble with wide voids, heavy tilt and many chinks.

limits: Stones are rotated, tapered rounded rectangles with noisy outlines in rough courses; there are no through stones, coping, batter or stones that cross courses. Voids are drawn as flat dark recesses, and chinks are small ellipses. Lichen and moss are noise patches, not grown. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced; deep voids read best with the height map for parallax or displacement.
technique_references: Courses of random height with stone lengths that wrap around the tile width
Rotated, tapered rounded-rectangle distance with noise-perturbed outlines
Nearest stone among five candidate slots per pixel
Ellipse stamping with wrap-around for chinking stones
Fractional Brownian motion of tileable gradient noise
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
